what_this_is: The Workshop rows for tools/space-members: a person joins a shared space by a join row that holds for them now, leaves it, shows a name in it, and anyone asks whether a person is a member now. Whether a member still counts is worked out on every ask from the space's join rows and what the person holds, never stored.

payload.label: Join a space
payload.job: Work out whether a person joins a shared space by the way its join rows allow (free, or holding the access a row names) and answer their member row
payload.description: Reads the space's record:space row and the person's record:space-member row from `records`. A person already in is answered with their type and how they came in, and nothing is answered to keep. Otherwise the space's config.join rows decide, as data: a row {free:true} lets anyone in, a row {access:"<ref>"} lets in a person who holds that access now (worked out by the paid-access reader over your payment events, offers and grants), and a space with no join rows is joined only by invitation (a person gets in by accepting one). A person who left may join again; a person a host put out stays out. The new member gets the type the space's label starts joiners with (or config.joins_as) and may give the name they will show with name. Answers whether they joined, their type and which row let them in, with the new member row under `keep` for the caller to store; a refusal says how the space is joined, in the space's own words (config.words) or the standard ones.

space.description: The space's id, the last part of its record:space row id

subject.description: The person, the way the space and your access rules name them

name.description: The name other members read for this person in this space (at most 80 characters)

records.description: The records the ask reads, as the caller read them from a store ({ id, type, value }): the space's record:space row, the member rows of the space (record:space-member), and, when a join row asks for access, the payment-event, record:commercial-offer, access-grant, access-effect-rule and effect-lifecycle rows. The run keeps nothing; a row to store comes back as `keep`.

keep.description: The rows to store, each { id, type, value, expected } with the whole row as value and expected the record as it was handed in (null for a new row); absent when nothing changed

payload.label: Leave a space
payload.job: Work out a member leaving a shared space and answer their member row marked left; what they put there stays
payload.description: Answers the person's record:space-member row marked left, stamped when, under `keep` for the caller to store. Leaving a space the person is not in answers nothing to keep. The person who runs the space cannot leave it: hand it over first. They may join again later by the space's join rows.

payload.label: Check someone is in a space
payload.job: Say whether a person is a member of a shared space right now, and why not when they are not
payload.description: The one answer to whether a person is a member now. It reads, from `records`, the space's join rows, the person's member row and what they hold now (paid-access), and answers member true or false with a state: member, lapsed (their access ended; they are members again the moment it holds), left, removed or none, plus the reason in words and their type and how they came in. A person who holds the access again after a refund is a member again with nothing written in between.

payload.label: List a space's members
payload.job: List who is in a shared space, by the name each chose to show, with their type; only members may ask
payload.description: Lists the space's record:space-member rows handed in as `records`: each person's id, the name they chose to show (never a contact), their member type and its label, and whether they count now (the same reader as tool:check-someone-is-in-a-space, over one read of what people hold). Only a current member may ask; anyone else is refused in the space's words. include_ended true also lists people who left, were put out or lapsed.

payload.label: Choose the name I show in a space
payload.job: Check a member's chosen name for one shared space and answer their member row with it, for other members to read
payload.description: Answers the person's own member row with the name set, at most 80 characters, under `keep` for the caller to store. Only a current member may. Members read this name and nothing else about them; their contact is never shown.
